[[File:West Ardougne Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''West Ardougne Teleport''' teleports the caster to [[West Ardougne]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. Completion of [[Biohazard]] is also required to cast the spell.
